LightningComponentBundle.description: Natural-language candidate search with Textkernel, job match, refine chat, explanations, compare and bulk actions. Reads c__jobId and c__q from the page state.

property.name: heading
property.label: Page title
property.description: Leave as Candidate Search to show it in English or French with the page language.

property.name: logoUrl
property.label: Logo URL (optional)
property.description: Image URL for the Amplify logo, for example /resource/AmplifyLogo. Blank shows the Amplify wordmark.

property.name: emailFlowApiName
property.label: Send email flow
property.description: API name of the packaged screen flow that sends email to the selected candidates (input recipientIds).

property.name: taskFlowApiName
property.label: Add task flow
property.description: API name of the packaged screen flow that adds a task or note for the selected candidates (input recordIds).
